claim_summary: For every nonzero quadratic analytic Hardy Hankel symbol \(\psi(z)=az+bz^2\), the normalized-Szegő-kernel test is at least \(5/(3\sqrt3)\) times the Hankel norm, with equality precisely at \(|a|/|b|=1/\sqrt6\).

integrity.proof_basis: explicit Hardy-basis matrix, scalar concavity, and rational polynomial positivity identity
integrity.supplemental_checks: 9853 finite checks executed in standalone verify.py; universal theorem is proved analytically

scientific_limitations: The constant is only claimed for symbols az+bz^2.
No conclusion is claimed for higher-degree, nonpolynomial, or general BMOA symbols.
Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive publication-priority certification have not been performed.
title: Sharp kernel-testing constant for quadratic Hardy Hankel symbols
